title: Jaspat Rai Threatens the Khalsa and Is Slain

blocks.text: Jaspat Rai's reply is meant to humiliate as much as frighten. The memory of Bhai Mani Singh's dismemberment was revived when he boasted that the Singhs could be cut to pieces, mutilated, and dragged before the Nawab in the same degrading fashion.
That threat hardens the Khalsa instead of cowing it. The Singhs first offer ardas and resolve on action, treating the confrontation as a test of honor rather than a mere dispute over provisions.

Once battle begins, the encounter ends quickly and decisively. The Singhs charged and struck with the sword, Jaspat Khatri was slain and his wealth taken, and the stores seized at Imnabad briefly relieved the desperation that had haunted the previous pages.
